**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Keep the ten-item threshold inclusive.**

The acceptance criteria require a discount when `itemCount >= 10`. With 10 items at 1,299 cents each, this condition returns a quote of 12,990 cents instead of 11,691 cents. The linked consumer maps `totalCents` to `amountDueCents` (`coderabbit-demo/security-harness-consumer/src/checkout.ts:17-26`).

- `tests/baseline.test.ts#L29-L30`: replace the self-comparison with literal expected quote values for item counts 9, 10, 11, and 15: 11,691, 11,691, 12,860, and 17,537 cents.
- `tests/baseline.test.ts#L59-L59`: assert the expected HTTP response fields and exact `totalCents`, not only property presence.
